segments.caption: A man is driving a white car along a tree-lined, leaf-strewn road, with the camera capturing both an interior view of him at the wheel and an exterior perspective of the vehicle moving through a park-like setting.

A white car is shown driving along a leaf-strewn road through a park, setting the scene for a practical guide. The video then transitions to a title card from Which? with the text "How to use a tyre repair kit," indicating the main event is an instructional tutorial on using a tyre repair kit, likely to follow the visual of the car's wheel.

A white car is shown parked on a leaf-strewn street, with the camera focusing on its silver alloy wheel. The scene then transitions inside the vehicle, where a finger presses the blue power button on the center console, initiating the car's startup sequence. The final shot shows the illuminated dashboard, highlighting the passenger airbag warning and seatbelt indicators, confirming the vehicle is now powered on.

A presenter examines a white car, starting with a close-up of the dashboard's illuminated warning lights, then moving to the exterior where he crouches to inspect the front wheel, suggesting he is conducting a detailed vehicle review or diagnostic check.

A man inspects his white Toyota, starting by checking the rear wheel, then moving to the rear bumper and license plate, and finally opening the trunk to look inside, all while crouching or leaning over the car parked on a leaf-strewn street.
A man retrieves a portable compressor and sealant from his car’s trunk, preparing to fix a flat tire, as shown by the close-up of the deflated wheel on the pavement.
A person is shown fixing a flat tire on a white car by applying sealant from a bottle into the valve stem, with the car parked on a leaf-strewn cobblestone street.

A man crouches by the rear passenger-side tire of a white car parked on a leaf-strewn sidewalk, using a portable compressor to inflate the tire. He gestures and speaks to the camera while working, indicating he is demonstrating or explaining the process of checking or inflating a car tire with an air compressor.

A man is shown charging his electric car, beginning by connecting a charging cable to the vehicle's charging port, then plugging the other end into a 12V socket inside the car, likely to power a device or as a temporary solution.
A person plugs a device into a car's 12V socket to power a portable tire inflator, which they then use to inflate a flat tire on the ground.

A close-up, low-angle shot captures the front wheel of a light-colored car as it slowly rolls forward over a cobblestone sidewalk scattered with fallen autumn leaves. The camera follows the tire’s movement, emphasizing the texture of the stone path and the seasonal debris.
A car is shown driving away from the camera down a residential street lined with autumn leaves, transitioning from a close-up of its wheel to a wider view of the road and surrounding buildings.
A man drives a white car along a tree-lined, leaf-strewn road, speaking to the camera as the vehicle moves forward, with a "Subscribe to our channel" graphic appearing on screen.
A man drives a white car along a tree-lined road, speaking to the camera as he navigates the scenic, leaf-strewn street.

The video begins with a view of a quiet, tree-lined road with parked cars, then cuts to a man driving and speaking to the camera. It transitions to a promotional segment from "Which?" advertising a one-month trial for £1, highlighting three services: finding the best buy tyres, tips on saving money on tyres, and a list of recommended breakdown companies.

This static promotional graphic from Which? invites viewers to sign up for a one-month trial for just £1. The main event is the offer itself, prominently displayed below the Which? logo. The scene context is automotive consumer advice, with three persistent visual cues—“Best Buy tyres,” “How to save money on tyres,” and “Recommended breakdown companies”—highlighting the service's core offerings. There are no actions or scene changes, as the image remains fixed throughout the sampled frames
